title: Musk's AI chatbot Grok gains US market share amid sexualized images backlash, data shows

title: Alphabet bonds' lack of guardrails highlights investor confidence
title_zh: Alphabet债券缺乏护栏凸显投资者信心
summary: Alphabet Inc's global bond sale this week underscored the high level of investor demand for the major AI hyperscalers, but raised concerns about the debt's lack of ‌protections for existing and future bondholders.
summary_zh: Alphabet Inc 本周的全球债券发行凸显了投资者对主要人工智能超大规模企业的高需求，但引发了人们对该债务缺乏对现有和未来债券持有人的保护的担忧。

title: SpaceX considering dual-class shares in IPO, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，SpaceX 考虑在 IPO 中采用双重股权结构
summary: Feb 13 (Reuters) - Elon Musk's SpaceX is considering a dual-class share structure in its planned IPO this year, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 路透 2 月 13 日 - 据彭博社周五援引知情人士消息报道，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下的 SpaceX 正在考虑在今年计划的 IPO 中采用双层股权结构。
